comparison.objective: Tune a damper from dynamic stopping response vs inspect concealed travel ranges and identify the largest slider.
comparison.physical_skill: Tool-mediated adjustment, locking, and repeated energetic cycling vs probing both mechanical stops of multiple sliders and marking the maximum range.
comparison.success_condition: Two safe repeated stops within force/travel limits and no setting drift vs every slider measured at both stops and the largest correctly identified.
comparison.reason: Both use empirical mechanical response rather than appearance, but concealed range comparison does not test fine adjustment, fastener locking, or damping performance. Numeric inspection tolerances are absent.
